name: Video & animation
short: Edit, caption, animate, and generate moving pictures
description: Tools for social clips, talking-head videos, tutorials, captioning, and generative video experiments. Some are full editors with AI helpers; others are generators with limited free credits. The best free choice depends on whether you need control, speed, or a short experimental clip.
tip: Get permission before using anyone's face, voice, or private footage. AI video tools may watermark exports, publish projects, or claim broad processing rights. For anything public or commercial, check the license, disclose synthetic media where required, and keep a backup of the original footage.

tools.name: CapCut
tools.signup: Free account for cloud and AI features; no card expected. Some effects point to Pro at the moment of use.
tools.free: Free desktop and mobile video editing with templates, auto captions, background removal, and a selection of AI-assisted tools.
tools.limits: Many AI effects, stock assets, higher-quality exports, and advanced controls are Pro-only. Availability, ownership, and data handling vary by region; review ByteDance's current terms.
tools.best_for: Short-form social videos, simple tutorials, and captioned clips with a fast editing workflow.

tools.name: DaVinci Resolve
tools.signup: Download the free version from Blackmagic Design; no card. Registration details may be requested.
tools.free: A genuinely free professional desktop editor with video editing, color correction, audio mixing, visual effects, and some AI-assisted features.
tools.limits: DaVinci Resolve Studio adds many Neural Engine features, higher resolutions, and collaboration tools. The free version is large, hardware-hungry, and not beginner-simple.
tools.best_for: Long-term video work where you want industry-grade editing without a subscription.

tools.name: Descript
tools.signup: Free Descript account; no card. Transcription and export limits apply.
tools.free: Edit video and audio by editing a transcript, with free transcription minutes, basic recording, and limited AI actions.
tools.limits: Transcription hours, resolution, exports, and advanced features are capped. Some exports carry restrictions, and higher usage or studio features need a paid plan.
tools.best_for: Podcast clips, talking-head videos, and tutorial edits when you prefer working from words.

tools.name: VEED
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Watermark and length limits apply to free exports.
tools.free: Free online video editor with subtitles, basic AI-assisted editing, screen recording, and templates.
tools.limits: Free exports are watermarked and limited in resolution/length. AI features and higher-quality exports require paid credits or a subscription.
tools.best_for: Quick browser-based clips with captions when you do not need a desktop editor.

tools.name: InVideo AI
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Weekly AI generation credits and watermarked exports apply.
tools.free: Generate a narrated video from a text prompt using stock footage, AI voice, captions, and an editable timeline.
tools.limits: The free plan has a small weekly or monthly AI generation allowance, watermarked exports, and limited access to voices and stock. Review stock and voice licensing.
tools.best_for: A fast draft explainer or promotional clip when you want a script-to-video starting point.

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Short, watermarked videos and a small monthly quota apply.
tools.free: Free avatar and AI presenter videos with a small monthly video allowance and a library of avatars and voices.
tools.limits: Free videos are short, watermarked, and limited in number. Custom avatars, longer videos, higher resolution, and commercial features are paid. Use only your own likeness or documented permission.
tools.best_for: A quick AI-presenter demo, training clip, or multilingual message without filming yourself.

tools.name: Runway
tools.signup: Free account; no card. A small one-time or periodic credit allowance applies.
tools.free: Limited free credits for AI video generation, image-to-video, editing experiments, and creative tools.
tools.limits: Free credits are small, watermarks and generation caps apply, and most serious usage needs a paid plan. Output length and model access change frequently.
tools.best_for: Testing generative video ideas and learning how AI video behaves before paying.

tools.name: Pika
tools.signup: Free account through supported sign-in; no card. Limited free generations and watermark rules apply.
tools.free: A limited free allowance of short AI video generations with creative effects and image-to-video options.
tools.limits: Free credits are limited and watermarks or lower priorities may apply. Advanced effects and longer/better-quality generation are paid. Review content and likeness rules.
tools.best_for: Short, playful visual effects and social clips that you can generate in a few passes.

tools.name: Luma Dream Machine
tools.signup: Free account; no card. A limited monthly generation allowance applies.
tools.free: A limited monthly allowance of text-to-video and image-to-video generations through Luma's web app.
tools.limits: Free generations are capped, queued, and may be watermarked or lower priority. Longer clips, newer models, and commercial/high-volume use are paid.
tools.best_for: Cinematic motion experiments and animating a still image for a short concept clip.

tools.name: Kling AI
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Daily login credits buy only a few short clips.
tools.free: Free daily login credits for text-to-video and image-to-video generation in a web interface.
tools.limits: Daily credits buy only a few short clips, generations can be slow, and free outputs may be watermarked. Higher resolution, longer clips, and priority processing are paid.
tools.best_for: Testing motion, camera moves, and image animations when you can work within a small daily credit budget.

tools.name: Hailuo AI
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Daily credits are limited and generations queue.
tools.free: A free daily allowance of short AI video generations from MiniMax, with text-to-video and image-to-video tools.
tools.limits: Free clips are short, queued, and often watermarked. Daily credits and model access can change, and high-resolution or longer output is paid.
tools.best_for: Quick motion tests and character animation ideas without committing to a subscription.

tools.name: Clipchamp
tools.signup: Free Microsoft account; no card. Some assets and AI tools are gated.
tools.free: Microsoft's browser video editor offers free editing, screen recording, templates, captions, and some AI tools with a Microsoft account.
tools.limits: Free exports may be limited in quality or features, stock assets vary, and several AI or premium tools require a paid plan. Check current watermarks and export settings.
tools.best_for: Simple tutorials and social videos on Windows or in the browser without learning a pro editor.

tools.name: Kapwing
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Free exports are watermarked and limited.
tools.free: Free browser editing with auto subtitles, templates, screen recording, and a limited amount of AI-assisted editing.
tools.limits: Free exports can be watermarked and capped in length or resolution. AI credits and brand assets are limited; higher-quality exports and longer AI usage are paid.
tools.best_for: Browser-based subtitle work and quick social edits without installing a desktop app.

tools.name: Wan
tools.signup: Download the official model or code; no account or card. You supply a capable GPU and setup time.
tools.free: Open-source video-generation models you can run locally, with text-to-video and image-to-video capabilities.
tools.limits: Very demanding on GPUs, storage, and setup time. Model licenses and acceptable-use terms still apply. Quality and speed depend heavily on hardware and settings.
tools.best_for: Technical users who want local control over generative video experiments.

tools.name: LTX-Video
tools.signup: Download the official model or code; no account or card. You supply the GPU and environment.
tools.free: Open-source, lightweight video-generation model and code intended for local experimentation and fast iteration.
tools.limits: Requires technical setup and substantial GPU resources for useful results. Model weights, licenses, and quality vary; local generation is not free cloud compute.
tools.best_for: Experimenters who want to test a faster open video model on their own hardware.
